links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified EAU patient education materials (8 original PEMs vs 8 GPT-4-generated PEMs)
links.outcome: Readability (FKRE, FKGL) of patient education materials, plus accuracy, completeness and clarity ratings by urologists
links.effect: Mean FKRE 43.5 (original) vs 70.8 (GPT-4), p < .001; mean FKGL 11.6 vs 6.1, p < .001; no significant differences in accuracy, completeness and clarity for localized or metastatic cancers; mean GPT-4 creation time 52.1 seconds
links.quote: The readability scores for the 8 original PEMs were lower than for the 8 GPT-4-generated PEMs (Mean FKRE: 43.5 vs. 70.8; p < .001).

design_hint: guideline grounding, reading-level adaptation, and native-speaker translation checks
